canvas_256_offset.meaning: point (x, y) of the normal 256x256 canvas = (16+x, 0+y) here; draw this frame at (pet_x - 16, pet_y - 0) where (pet_x, pet_y) is the top-left of the normal 256 frame -> no position jump

ds_sweep_start.notes: start (one-shot, 4 frames): idle -> pop cut to the broom (1); then play ds_sweep_loop from frame 2

ds_sweep_loop.notes: sweep loop 0-15: 1 broom set down right (scuff) -> 2 stroke left + dust puff -> 3 follow-through + 2 px step + dust -> 4 swing back, humming note; squash pop on every cut

ds_sweep_end.notes: ending (one-shot, play after loop frame 15): pop cut to 5 (leaning on the broom, wiping the forehead), the dust pile pops up beside her, phew hold; ends on 5 (the app returns to idle with its usual hard cut)
